title: Add rocket feature to .agent/PROMPT.md loop template
description: Update the default PROMPT.md template to include a description of the 'rocket feature' command so the AI agent running in rocket loop is aware it exists.
acceptanceCriteria: Description explains what the command does
Description explains when to suggest it (when user wants to add a feature)
Description explains that it generates tasks automatically

steps.details: Add a section to the default PROMPT.md content: '## Available Commands\n\n**rocket feature** — When the user mentions wanting to add a new feature or capability, suggest using `rocket feature "<feature description>"`. It will generate a spec, ask clarifying questions, and automatically add tasks to tasks.json.'
